supplements.title: Natural Products Targeting the PI3K/Akt/mTOR-Mediated Autophagy Pathway in Cancer Therapy: Recent Advances and Clinical Perspectives.
supplements.summary: Natural products targeting the PI3K/Akt/mTOR pathway can modulate autophagy, potentially suppressing cancer cell proliferation and enhancing treatment effectiveness.

supplements.title: The Impact of Zinc on Cellular Dynamics, Brain Function, and its Therapeutic Potential in Neuronal Regeneration.
supplements.summary: Zinc plays a crucial role in neural function and regeneration, potentially offering therapeutic strategies for brain injury and neurodegenerative disorders through cellular repair mechanisms.

supplements.title: Vascular normalization by erianin unleashes CAR-T immunotherapy in glioblastoma.
supplements.summary: Erianin, a natural compound, normalizes blood vessels in glioblastoma, improving CAR-T cell therapy by enhancing T cell infiltration and activity.

supplements.title: High-protein diets increase microbiota associated p-cresol production in the colon and reduce gut barrier function in a sex-dependent manner.
supplements.summary: In female and male pigs, high-protein diets increased harmful gut bacteria metabolites and reduced gut barrier function differently by sex.

supplements.title: Associations of six dietary patterns with all-cause and cause-specific mortality among individuals with depression in the UK biobank: a prospective cohort study.
supplements.summary: Diet plays an important role in the development of depression, but the impact of dietary patterns on mortality in individuals with depression is unclear.

supplements.title: Fungi as a source of anticancer agents: metabolic products and their functional implications.
supplements.summary: Fungi, especially endophytic species, produce diverse metabolites that can kill cancer cells through multiple mechanisms like oxidative stress and mitochondrial damage.

supplements.title: Enterolactone and THBS1-3TSR synergistically inhibit ovarian cancer and suppress angiogenesis in the tumour microenvironment.
supplements.summary: Enterolactone and THBS1-3TSR work together to reduce ovarian cancer growth by blocking blood vessel formation in the tumor environment.

supplements.title: Multiomics combined drugs to explore the potential mechanism and treatment of ankylosing spondylitis.
supplements.summary: Multiomics research reveals elevated CD8+ memory T cells and potential guava leaf compounds as a promising treatment for ankylosing spondylitis.

supplements.title: Pharmacokinetic studies and synergistic antitumor effects of cannabichromene and cannabidiol in drug-resistant breast cancers.
supplements.summary: Cannabichromene and cannabidiol combined effectively inhibit drug-resistant triple-negative breast cancer by reducing tumor growth and blocking key cancer-promoting pathways.

supplements.title: Inhibition of Antioxidant Genes Expression in Echinococcus Granulosus by Baicalein: Implications for Novel Antiparasitic Strategies.
supplements.summary: Baicalein effectively inhibits antioxidant gene expression in Echinococcus granulosus parasites, offering a potential alternative to traditional hydatid cyst treatments.

supplements.title: Phytochemical and pharmacological elucidation of Jasonia glutinosa (L.) fourr. essential oil: a promising therapeutic source against inflammation and cancer.
supplements.summary: Jasonia glutinosa essential oil showed selective cytotoxicity against multiple cancer cell lines, particularly breast and liver cancer, while demonstrating strong anti-inflammatory properties.

supplements.title: Ginkgetin inhibits non-small cell lung cancer via the HSP90-AKT signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Ginkgetin, a natural compound from Ginkgo biloba, inhibits non-small cell lung cancer cell growth by targeting the HSP90-AKT signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Five daucane-type sesquiterpenes isolated from the roots of Ferula songarica Pall. ex Schult. and their anti-gastric cancer activity.
supplements.summary: Researchers discovered three potent compounds from Ferula songarica roots that effectively inhibit gastric cancer cell growth in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Modulating the gut-reproductive tract axis: microbial influence on gynaecological cancer pathogenesis and treatment.
supplements.summary: Gut microbiota composition significantly influences ovarian, endometrial, and cervical cancer development, progression, and treatment response through immune and metabolic mechanisms.

supplements.title: Multifunctional drug delivery of nanofibrous iron-polyphenolic nanochelates improved photothermal therapy against colorectal cancer via ferroptosis.
supplements.summary: Nanofibrous iron-polyphenolic nanochelates enhanced photothermal therapy for colorectal cancer by improving ferroptosis and triggering an immune response.

off_label.title: Neratinib, a Clinical Drug Treating Breast Cancer, Protects Against Vascular Inflammation and Atherosclerosis.
off_label.summary: Neratinib, a breast cancer drug, demonstrates potential to reduce vascular inflammation and slow atherosclerosis progression by targeting key inflammatory pathways.

off_label.title: Mass Spectrometry Monitoring of Water Dimer Radical Cations for Highly Efficient Dye Degradation.
off_label.summary: Water dimer radical cations efficiently degraded rhodamine B dye, achieving 99% removal in 8 minutes without additional chemicals, using a corona discharge method.

off_label.title: Current and Future Pharmacological Interventions for Acquired Hypothalamic Obesity.
off_label.summary: Emerging pharmacological therapies targeting disturbed brain pathways show promise in treating acquired hypothalamic obesity by addressing unique metabolic disruptions.

off_label.title: Impact of prenatal sirolimus on cardiac rhabdomyomas and brain tubers.
off_label.summary: Prenatal sirolimus treatment reduced tumor size and improved cardiac outcomes in fetuses with cardiac rhabdomyomas associated with tuberous sclerosis complex.

off_label.title: Inhibition of acalabrutinib metabolism by finerenone and its molecular docking studies.
off_label.summary: Finerenone inhibits acalabrutinib metabolism in chronic lymphocytic leukemia, potentially increasing the drug's exposure and requiring adjusted dosing strategies.

off_label.title: Short-term hormonal modulation with mifepristone does not induce oncogenic changes in the endometrium of BRCA1/2 pathogenic variant carriers.
off_label.summary: Mifepristone, a potential breast cancer prevention drug for BRCA1/2 mutation carriers, showed no harmful changes in the endometrium during short-term use.

off_label.title: SAICAR Drives T Regulatory Cell Differentiation and FOXP3 Maintenance to Promote Immunotherapy Resistance.
off_label.summary: SAICAR, a metabolite, promotes suppressive T cells in tumors, blocking immunotherapy effectiveness and suggesting a potential treatment strategy.

off_label.title: Inhibition of Antioxidant Genes Expression in Echinococcus Granulosus by Baicalein: Implications for Novel Antiparasitic Strategies.
off_label.summary: Baicalein effectively inhibits antioxidant gene expression in Echinococcus granulosus parasites, offering a potential alternative to traditional hydatid cyst treatments.

off_label.title: Exploring FDA-approved small molecules for their potential as PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors: integrating computational screening with experimental testing.
off_label.summary: Researchers used computational screening to identify FDA-approved small molecules that could potentially block PD-1/PD-L1 interactions and enhance cancer immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Targeting ERLIN1 reveals a coordinated cholesterol-dependent vulnerability in hepatocellular carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Researchers discovered that targeting the ERLIN1 protein disrupts cholesterol regulation in liver cancer cells, potentially offering a new treatment approach.

off_label.title: The NADPH oxidase inhibitor Vas2870 prevents myocyte ferroptosis and improves cardiac remodelling and function in doxorubicin-induced cardiomyopathy.
off_label.summary: Researchers found that blocking a specific cellular enzyme with the drug Vas2870 can protect heart muscle cells from damage and improve heart function in patients experiencing chemotherapy-related ...

off_label.title: Quaternized Chitosan-Ferulic Acid-Based Nanomicelles for Dimethoxycurcumin Delivery and Synergistic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma Therapy with 5-Fluorouracil.
off_label.summary: Nanomicelles loaded with dimethoxycurcumin enhanced colorectal cancer cell death when combined with 5-fluorouracil, showing selective tumor targeting and reduced toxicity.

off_label.title: Exploring synergistic therapeutic potential of Erlotinib and artemisinin in non-small cell lung Cancer (NSCLC) using pharmacological networking and mathematical modeling.
off_label.summary: Exploring synergistic therapeutic potential of Erlotinib and artemisinin in non-small cell lung Cancer (NSCLC) using pharmacological networking and mathematical modeling.

off_label.title: Combination of artesunate and ruxolitinib suppresses T cell leukemia/lymphoma proliferation via the JAK STAT pathway.
off_label.summary: Combining artesunate and ruxolitinib effectively suppresses T-cell leukemia/lymphoma cell growth by inhibiting the JAK/STAT pathway and promoting cancer cell death.

off_label.title: Upconversion mesoporous silica nanoparticles co-delivering celecoxib and rose bengal enable multimodal immunogenic and anti-angiogenic therapy for spinal metastasis of non-small cell lung cancer.
off_label.summary: Nanoparticles delivering celecoxib and rose bengal triggered immunogenic cell death and reduced angiogenesis in non-small cell lung cancer with spinal metastasis.

biomarkers.title: Decoding RNA-protein interactions using high-throughput methods.
biomarkers.summary: High-throughput experimental methods are revealing the complex interactions between RNA-binding proteins and RNA sequences, enhancing our understanding of gene expression mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: Assessment of cytotoxicity and induction of apoptosis by cytolysin-A in MCF-7 human breast cancer cell line.
biomarkers.summary: Cytolysin A shows promising selective toxicity against MCF-7 breast cancer cells by inducing apoptosis while minimally affecting normal cells.

biomarkers.title: ARP2/3 complex mediates the neuropathology of PTEN-deficient human neural cells downstream of mTORC1 and mTORC2 hyperactivation.
biomarkers.summary: In PTEN-deficient neural cells, ARP2/3 complex inhibition can reverse neurodevelopmental disorder symptoms by reducing cell proliferation and neuronal hyperactivity.

biomarkers.title: Utility of serum biomarkers for prostate cancer diagnosis in the magnetic resonance imaging era.
biomarkers.summary: The discovery of prostate-specific antigen (PSA) as a biomarker in prostate cancer has enriched the field of uro-oncology, offering valuable insights for disease monitoring, management decisions an...

biomarkers.title: Cytokine use in the Hematopoietic Subsyndrome of Acute Radiation Syndrome (H-ARS): Implications for the role of cytokines in a mass casualty radiologic/nuclear (R/N) emergency.
biomarkers.summary: Sargramostim showed promising survival benefits in non-human primates exposed to radiation, supporting its potential use as a cytokine treatment for acute radiation syndrome.

biomarkers.title: Effectiveness of Educational Videos in Encouraging Preferences for Guideline-Based Cancer Screening in Japan: Three-Arm Pseudorandomized Controlled Trial.
biomarkers.summary: An educational video intervention effectively improved Japanese participants' understanding of appropriate cancer screening guidelines, potentially reducing unnecessary screenings.

biomarkers.title: Unraveling the Tapestry: Lessons from multiomics and spatial biology in hepatocellular cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Spatial omics technologies reveal how cellular interactions in the liver cancer microenvironment influence tumor progression, immune response, and potential treatment strategies.

biomarkers.title: Ibrutinib with venetoclax in patients with relapsed/refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia: A phase II study.
biomarkers.summary: The combination of ibrutinib and venetoclax showed high response rates and prolonged progression-free survival in patients with relapsed/refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

biomarkers.title: Association of immune checkpoint inhibitors with muscle mass and density in patients with melanoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers investigated how immune checkpoint inhibitors affect muscle mass and density in melanoma patients, exploring potential links with kidney function.

biomarkers.title: Integrated Near-Infrared Light-Driven Janus Micromotor-Fluorescent Nanodiamond Dynamic Sensing Platform for Active Motion-Enhanced Biodetection.
biomarkers.summary: A near-infrared-powered micromotor platform with fluorescent nanodiamonds enhances microRNA and protein detection sensitivity by improving mass transport and capture efficiency.

biomarkers.title: Poxvirus attack of antiviral defense pathways unleashes an effector-triggered NF-κB response.
biomarkers.summary: A poxvirus effector protein triggers an immune response by disrupting antiviral defense proteins, activating NF-κB signaling in human cells.

biomarkers.title: Synergistic Gene Immunotherapy for Lung Cancer via Targeted Nanomedicine Restoring Genetic Tumor Suppression and Activating STING Pathway.
biomarkers.summary: A targeted nanoparticle delivery system restores tumor suppressor genes and activates immune response, effectively inhibiting non-small cell lung cancer progression.

biomarkers.title: Al18F-NOTA-FAPI-04 PET/CT for diagnosis of breast cancer and its correlation with pathological features: A single-center retrospective study.
biomarkers.summary: A new PET/CT imaging technique using a specialized tracer showed promising ability to detect and characterize breast cancer tumors with high accuracy.

biomarkers.title: Communication and information needs of patients with cancer in Ghana: A scoping review.
biomarkers.summary: A comprehensive review highlights the critical need for culturally sensitive communication guidelines in cancer care in Ghana to improve patient support and treatment outcomes.
